dedupe_keys.name: puntos de vertido de depuradoras urbanas q2013 dir 91 271 cee

description: Puntos de vertido de depuradoras urbanas (Q2013. Dir 91/271/CEE) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. Position of discharge points from treatment plants in accordance with Directive 91/271/EEC on urban waste water treatment. Information on sewage treatment plants, their discharge points and sensitive areas has been sent to the European Commission according to the data model specified on the EIONET website, and its contents can be found on the website. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Discharge points for urban wastewater treatment plants (Q2013. Dir 91/271/EEC)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WMTS. The listing shows 2020-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
